mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_conversation_message (session_id, run_id, role, content, create_time) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{runId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, run_id, role, content, create_time FROM ( SELECT id, session_id, run_id, role, content, create_time FROM ai_agent_conversation_message message WHERE message.session_id = #{sessionId} AND message.id > #{afterMessageId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_conversation_message user_message WHERE user_message.run_id = message.run_id AND user_message.role = 'USER' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_conversation_message assistant_message WHERE assistant_message.run_id = message.run_id AND assistant_message.role = 'ASSISTANT' ) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent_messages ORDER BY id ASC
